opening.argument: The presentation promotes BitClub membership and paid mining-pool participation, with entry prices ranging from $99 to $3,500, while tying account credits, provisioning payments, team sales, and account cycles to bonuses. It states that “Pool 1 costs you $500” and that “The Cycle Bonus is paid every 24 hours and is a significant portion of your income.” Its binary structure also links payments to purchases made by team members, encouraging the addition of members and presenting a claim of up to $2,000 daily per account. The $2 million monthly figure is described as a team result rather than a guaranteed future return. The e-wallet link and tablet amount do not establish a promised return or completed outcome.
